amt-mpuu.description: AMT Medicinal Product Unit of Use — template accounts for ingredient modifications

amt-tpuu.description: AMT Trade Product Unit of Use — template accounts for ingredient modifications

clinical-drug.description: SNOMED CT medicinal products narrowed to strength-bearing concepts by requiring 732943007 |Has basis of strength substance|. Falls back to 'product' when an ingredient yields no strength-bearing concept in the requested edition.

product.description: SNOMED CT international medicinal product hierarchy

product-oral.description: SNOMED CT medicinal products constrained to an oral dose form. Matches AMT trade products too, since AMT TPUUs are descendants of 373873005 with a manufactured dose form.
